In [[3956 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> a '''municipal authority''' agency existed in [[Garang]], [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine's]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]]. They would step in whenever a crime was being committed and would record the events in an archive, which could later be accessed by [[Analysis droid/Legends|information droids]]. Around the time of the [[Destruction of Taris|destruction]] of [[Taris/Legends|Taris]], the authorities had to prevent a fight between [[Calder Nettic]] and [[Rickard Lusoff]] inside a [[Garang spaceport cantina|cantina]] attached to the [[Garang spaceport]]. The [[Garang archives|archive]] of this event was later accessed during an investigation into Nettic's death carried out by [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Bolook]] and [[Revan/Legends|Revan]].<ref name="KOTOR" />
